name: Choose Life
overview: Scripture calls believers to make a deliberate choice for life by serving the Lord and embracing His blessings rather than death and curses, as seen in Deuteronomy 30:19 and Joshua 24:15. Life is portrayed as a sacred gift from God, intimately known and formed in the womb (Psalms 139:13; Jeremiah 1:5), and is ultimately fulfilled through faith in Jesus Christ, who offers abundant and eternal life (John 3:16; John 10:10). Choosing life, therefore, means committing to God’s way and receiving the fullness of life He provides both now and forever.
